questions.q: Which field on a gap/solution log describes what happens to the business if the gap is left unresolved?
options: Gap ID
Owner
Status
Business impact
questions.explain: Business impact describes the consequence of not closing the gap, such as a lost control or a report that can't be produced.

questions.q: Which solution option involves the business changing how it works rather than changing the system?
options: Extension
Personalization
Process workaround
Configuration
questions.explain: A process workaround means the business adjusts its own process, with no change to the system itself.

questions.q: What two factors typically drive a steering committee's prioritization decision on a logged gap?
options: The requirement's creation date and the consultant's seniority
Business impact and effort estimate
The number of bank accounts and the legal entity count
The TCM phase name and the RAID log length
questions.explain: Business impact and effort estimate together drive prioritization: high-impact, low-effort gaps are approved quickly, while low-impact, high-effort gaps are often deferred.

questions.q: What does "deferred/backlog" mean as a solution option for a logged gap?
options: The gap is acknowledged but not solved in the current phase
The gap is immediately built as an extension
The gap is reclassified as a fit
The gap is escalated to an Oracle Service Request
questions.explain: Deferred/backlog means the gap is acknowledged and logged, but not addressed during the current implementation phase.

questions.q: How was Brightfield's GAP-CM-03 (the legacy Treasury report format) classified and resolved?
options: As a fit requiring no changes
As a process gap requiring Treasury to change its reporting habits
As an extension gap, resolved with a custom BI Publisher report approved by the steering committee
As out of scope with no proposed solution
questions.explain: GAP-CM-03 was logged as an extension gap with a proposed custom BI Publisher report, estimated at three consultant-days, and approved by the steering committee.
